slides.title: What does the EU ask of Ethiopia and Eritrea?

slides.text: In a statement dated **Oct 5**, the EU calls for **immediate de-escalation on all fronts** and restraint in actions and rhetoric.
It asks the parties to the **Cessation of Hostilities Agreement** to recommit to it within the **African Union** framework.
The EU says **civilians must be protected** and **humanitarian access** must be unhindered.
**Protect civilians, choose dialogue.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: EU High Representative statement, Oct 5, 2026
